# SimpleCard

```ts
import { SimpleCard } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The vertical media card template (Figma _elements / simple card, node 183:11859). It's content that slots into a Card: a full-bleed media area on top, then a title with an optional overflow menu, a body paragraph, and an actions row.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Full-bleed media on top — an image or any node; clipped to the Card's corners. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The card title (Figma 18px bold.18). |
| `menu` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Trailing overflow control beside the title — a cake& IconButton (e.g. a "⋮" menu). |
| `body` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Body paragraph (Figma 14px regular.14.body, secondary color). |
| `actions` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Actions row — a cake& Button or button group. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Card, SimpleCard } from '@/cakeand/components/Card';
import { Button } from '@/cakeand/components/Button';
import { IconButton } from '@/cakeand/components/Button';

<Card>
  <SimpleCard
    media={<img src="cover.jpg" alt="" />}
    title="Simple card title"
    menu={<IconButton size="sm" variant="ghost" label="More options" icon={<MoreVertical />} />}
    body="Lorem ipsum…"
    actions={<Button size="sm" variant="outline" intent="secondary" endIcon={<ArrowRight />}>Label</Button>}
  />
</Card>
```

## Design tokens used

`--space-500`, `--space-300`, `--space-200`, `--color-surfaces-on-container`, `--type-size-subtitle`, `--font-weight-bold`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--type-size-body`, `--color-text-icon-secondary`

## Accessibility

- The title renders as an <h3>; keep heading order coherent with the page.
- The menu IconButton requires a label — it announces "More options" even though only the "⋮" glyph shows.
- Give real media an alt (or alt="" if decorative); the slot adds none.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use full-bleed media so it meets the Card's corners | Pad the media — it should reach the rounded edges |
| Put row-level overflow actions in menu | Crowd the title row with several icon buttons |
| Slot it into a <Card> | Render it bare — it has no surface or elevation of its own |
